recognitionRules: Use Trebuchet route headings with plain Arial instructions.
Make the route choice visible before the activities.
Keep each investigation to a looking prompt, an action and a response.
Separate optional extensions from the core visit.
Use blue response boundaries and pale amber guide-dialogue strips; keep route drawings and black instructions distinct.

writingLinks.reason: Observation and dialogue prompts that help visitors discover through questions.

quote: Choose a route. Look for one detail. See where it leads.

logoDirection: Use THREE SMALL INVESTIGATIONS in Trebuchet with three open dots connected by separate short strokes. Avoid a single mandatory path arrow.
invariants: Use Trebuchet route headings with plain Arial instructions.
Make the route choice visible before the activities.

adaptations: A family sheet can use larger response spaces.
A mobile version preserves route choice and one investigation per screen.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
